KVM: x86: Rename kvm_lapic_enable_pv_eoi()

kvm_lapic_enable_pv_eoi() is a misnomer as the function is also
used to disable PV EOI. Rename it to kvm_lapic_set_pv_eoi().

No functional change intended.
